snapshot.agent_notes: Read-only public dimensional-profile reference. The dimensional-weight value is a static reference calculation using divisor 139 and is not a live carrier quote, checkout rate, delivery promise, supplier-cost, margin, customer, order, cart, private freight, or payment claim. No account, authentication, API key, credentials, token, payment, or password data is exposed. Confirm live price, stock, shipping, and checkout availability on Packrift.com before purchase handoff.
